disclaimer: General information about Florida and federal fishing rules, framed per species. Not legal advice. Seasons change by executive order and temporary rule; check FWC and NOAA before each trip. Posted signage on site controls.

regions_def.atlantic: Florida state waters of the Atlantic Ocean (shore to 3 nm). For reef fish the Atlantic/Gulf line is the one in r. 68B-14.002 (83 W, 24 35 N, Rebecca Shoal, Key West, US 1 to the mainland); other chapters define their own lines, and the king mackerel rules put Monroe County with the Gulf.
regions_def.gulf: Florida state waters of the Gulf (shore to 9 nm), north and west of the r. 68B-14.002 line; includes Florida Bay and Keys bay side.
regions_def.keys: All Monroe County state waters, given only where Monroe differs (grouper rules treat all Monroe waters as Atlantic).
regions_def.eez_sa: South Atlantic EEZ off Florida (50 C.F.R. part 622 subparts I, M, Q; part 635).
regions_def.eez_gulf: Gulf EEZ off Florida (50 C.F.R. part 622 subparts B, E, Q; part 635).

spear_def.prohibited: Spear, gig or other piercing gear may not be used for this species anywhere listed, or all harvest is closed.
spear_def.allowed: No species rule found that excludes spear as gear in state or federal waters. Size, bag and season limits apply, and so do the place-based closures shown on the map.
spear_def.restricted: A species rule limits spear as gear: only in some of the listed waters, or only under a gear or permit condition; or the species is closed for at least half the year in at least one region, or its 2026 season was set by executive order or temporary rule. Read the region details before taking one.

general_notes: Spearing is closed by place regardless of species: Upper Keys (Miami-Dade line through Long Key), state park waters, 100 yd from beaches, piers and fishing bridges, 100 ft from jetties, FKNMS no-take zones, Dry Tortugas NP, and others on the map.
No powerhead or bangstick harvest in state waters; no harvest on a rebreather except lionfish (r. 68B-20.003(7)).
Rule 68B-20.005 says 'spearing', which covers gigging and bow fishing as well as spearfishing (r. 68B-20.002).
State Reef Fish Angler designation (r. 68B-14.009) is required to harvest the 13 listed species while aboard a vessel in Florida waters; shore divers are not covered by that trigger.
Size: TL is total length, FL is fork length, both straight-line (50 C.F.R. 622.2). CFL is curved fork length (tunas).
Two South Atlantic SMZs off Florida prohibit spearfishing gear (50 C.F.R. 622.182); see the map layer, not this panel.
Reef fish must be landed whole: no fillets on the water, a pier, a fishing bridge or a jetty (r. 68B-14.006(4)); federal waters require head and fins intact (50 C.F.R. §§ 622.10(a), 622.186(a)).
A boat harvesting reef fish in state waters, spearfishing included, must carry a venting tool or rigged descending device (r. 68B-14.005(3)).
A speargun may not be used or possessed in or upon fresh water (r. 68A-23.002(7)); in national parks a loaded speargun in any vessel is prohibited (36 C.F.R. § 2.4(c)).

species.name: Golden tilefish
species.spear_note: Spear not excluded as gear (reef fish rule r. 68B-14.005 covers tilefish), but the fish lives in several hundred feet of water. Labelled restricted because the species is closed for most of the year in at least one region, or its 2026 season was cut short.

atlantic.bag: 1 per person, within 3 grouper aggregate (r. 68B-14.0036(7)(a))

gulf.bag: FWC: 2 per person or 100 lb, whichever is greater

species.name: Blueline tilefish
species.spear_note: Spear not excluded as gear (reef fish rule r. 68B-14.005 covers tilefish), but the fish lives in deep water. Labelled restricted because the species is closed for most of the year in at least one region, or its 2026 season was cut short.

atlantic.bag: 2 per person, within 3 grouper aggregate; for-hire captain and crew 0

gulf.bag: FWC: 2 per person or 100 lb, whichever is greater
gulf.season: No Gulf state-water season rule found (r. 68B-14.0039(5) is Atlantic).
gulf.closed: FWC's page lists May 1 to Aug 31 for Gulf state waters too. Conservative reading: treat as closed Sep 1 to Apr 30.

keys.bag: 2 per person within 3 grouper aggregate (bag rule covers all Monroe waters)
keys.closed: Conservative reading: closed Sep 1 to Apr 30.
keys.notes: Whether the r. 68B-14.0039(5) season reaches the Gulf side of Monroe was not read.

eez_sa.closed: Recurring: closed Jan 1 to Apr 30 and Sep 1 to Dec 31 (622.183(b)(7)).

species.name: Spiny lobster
species.spear_note: No device that could puncture, penetrate or crush the shell or flesh (r. 68B-24.006(10)); no spear, hook or similar device in the EEZ (622.404(a)). Take by hand or net.

atlantic.notes: Season and bag not verified here (FWC: Aug 6 to Mar 31; 6 per person).

eez_sa.notes: Possessing a speared or punctured lobster is prima facie evidence of prohibited gear.
